_README: Escalation routing. When the bot cannot answer, the student fills a short form in
the chat widget. It is submitted to ONE Google Form; an Apps Script attached to the
response sheet then files each row into the sheet tab for that student's department,
based on the first two letters of the roll number (CH23B043 -> CH -> Chemical).
1. Create a Google Form with three short-answer questions, in this order:
2. In the Form: ⋮ menu -> 'Get pre-filled link'. Type these EXACT dummy values:
3. Run:  npm run setup-form "<paste the copied link here>"
That fills in 'form' below automatically — you never touch entry IDs by hand.
4. Attach the Apps Script from google-apps-script/segregate.gs to the response
sheet so rows are sorted into per-department tabs.
5. git add -A && git commit -m 'escalation form' && git push
Until 'form.actionUrl' is filled in, the widget falls back to the plain
'data-escalate-url' link, so nothing breaks in the meantime.
